target_slug.description: One of the candidate slugs shown below. Anything else is discarded. There is no prereq_slug: the source skill is fixed by the caller, so this answer can never invert a direction.

confidence.description: How certain the candidate's own excerpt makes this dependency. Below 0.6 is discarded.

evidence.description: The phrase from THAT CANDIDATE'S excerpt showing it uses the source skill. Not from the source's own text, and not a justification you wrote.
